name: Galleria at Tyler
description: Galleria at Tyler is a premier regional shopping destination in Riverside, California, featuring top national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. Managed by Simon Property Group, this enclosed mall serves the Inland Empire with a diverse mix of fashion, lifestyle, and specialty stores. The center provides a comfortable year-round shopping experience with modern amenities and convenient access from major highways.
summary: A major enclosed regional mall in Riverside's Inland Empire offering over 130 stores with fashion, dining, and entertainment options.
